questions.question_english: Which of these best describes the primary objective of the Central Government Health Scheme (CGHS)?
options_english: To provide free elective cosmetic surgeries and aesthetic treatments to serving employees
To grant comprehensive life insurance cover and pension benefits to active employees
To establish specialized medical colleges exclusively for children of serving employees
To provide comprehensive medical care to Central Government employees and pensioners
questions.explanation_english: To provide comprehensive medical care to Central Government employees and pensioners. The primary mandate of the Central Government Health Scheme is to provide comprehensive, quality healthcare services to serving employees, pensioners, and eligible dependents. The scheme offers holistic preventive, curative, and rehabilitative care through wellness centres, empanelled private hospitals, diagnostic facilities, and various recognized systems of medicine across covered cities.

questions.question_english: Does CGHS cover the cost of hearing aids?
options_english: No, hearing aids are categorized as personal luxury items and are not reimbursable
Yes, subject to ENT specialist recommendation and prescribed ceiling rates for hearing aids

Only for serving Group A officers and their dependent family members
questions.explanation_english: Yes, subject to ENT specialist recommendation and prescribed ceiling rates for hearing aids. Hearing aids are admissible for financial reimbursement under scheme guidelines for eligible beneficiaries suffering from documented hearing impairment. Obtaining reimbursement requires formal clinical evaluation and recommendation by an official ENT specialist, with financial settlement capped at prescribed ceiling rates fixed by the Ministry of Health.

options_hindi: CS(MA) केवल सेवानिवृत्त पेंशनभोगियों पर लागू होता है, जबकि CGHS सभी सेवारत कर्मचारियों के लिए अनिवार्य है
CS(MA) वाणिज्यिक स्वास्थ्य बीमा की तरह चलता है, जबकि CGHS में कोई मासिक अंशदान नहीं होता

CS(MA) गैर-CGHS क्षेत्रों में प्रतिपूर्ति के जरिए लागू होता है, जबकि CGHS वेलनेस केंद्रों के जरिए सीधे देखभाल देता है
questions.question_english: What is the fundamental difference between the CS(MA) Rules and the CGHS?

CS(MA) applies in non-CGHS areas via reimbursement, while CGHS provides care directly via wellness centres
questions.explanation_english: CS(MA) applies in non-CGHS areas via reimbursement, while CGHS provides care directly via wellness centres. Central Services Medical Attendance Rules operate in non- scheme zones through an Authorised Medical Attendant network with post-treatment financial reimbursement, whereas the Health Scheme functions in notified cities providing direct outpatient care through network wellness centres and empanelled facilities.

questions.question_english: When a government servant undergoes treatment at a recognized government hospital, and the hospital does not supply a specific required medicine, what is the protocol for reimbursement?

questions.question_english: Which of these defines “Continuous Medical Attendance” under CS(MA) Rules?
options_english: Continuous intensive hospital care provided to a patient round-the-clock for an indefinite period
Treatment under the AMA for a specific illness up to the limit before specialist referral
A lifetime government guarantee of free medical consultations, diagnostics, and essential drugs
Specialized home nursing care provided continuously by certified private nurses or family members
questions.explanation_english: Treatment under the AMA for a specific illness up to the limit before specialist referral. Under Central Services (Medical Attendance) Rules, continuous medical attendance refers to treatment administered by an Authorised Medical Attendant for a specific illness episode up to prescribed limits (like ten days) prior to requiring specialist referral, ensuring structured primary medical care within official regulatory boundaries.

questions.question_english: A serving school Principal residing in a CGHS- covered area develops a mild fever and cough. According to the CGHS procedure, what is the correct first step the Principal should take?
options_english: Directly admit himself to a private empanelled hospital for observation
Claim a medical advance from the Head of Department
Visit the nearest CGHS Wellness Centre for consultation with a medical officer
Purchase medicines from a private pharmacy and submit a reimbursement claim without consultation
questions.explanation_english: Visit the nearest CGHS Wellness Centre for consultation with a medical officer. questions.question_english: A school Principal is processing a medical bill for a subordinate under CS(MA) rules. The employee purchased an expensive “food supplement” prescribed by a private doctor. According to the rules, how should this item be handled in the reimbursement claim?
options_english: Excluded, as food supplements and tonics are inadmissible under rules
Reimbursed fully in all cases, provided it was formally prescribed by a registered physician
Reimbursed partially at a fixed rate of 50% of the total claimed purchase cost
Forwarded directly to the Ministry of Finance for special administrative relaxation and approval
questions.explanation_english: Excluded, as food supplements and tonics are inadmissible under rules. Statutory lists of inadmissible items under medical attendance rules strictly prohibit reimbursement for general nutritional supplements, tonics, energy drinks, baby foods, and cosmetic preparations. Even if prescribed by a registered doctor, such items cannot be reimbursed, and administrative authorities must deduct them from total claim amounts.

key_facts: Answer key: (A)
